2.1 differential TFs heatmap acorrding pseudotime

library(tradeSeq)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(monocle)
library(dplyr)
cds <- readRDS("D:/HSC_Autophagy/Markdown/3.scATFR/ext_data/EHT_analysis/pseudotime/HSMM.rds")
col_data <- cds@phenoData@data
pseudotime <- col_data[order(col_data$Pseudotime),'Pseudotime',drop=F] %>% as.matrix()
colnames(pseudotime) <- "HSC"
cell_weight <- matrix(1,nrow=nrow(pseudotime))
dimnames(cell_weight) <- list(row.names(pseudotime), "HSC")

x <- pseudotime[,1]
r <- range(x)
b <- seq(from = r[1], to = r[2], length.out = (100))
X <- table(cut(x, breaks = b , include.lowest = TRUE))


stages <- c("AEC","HEC","T1_pre_HSC","T2_pre_HSC","FL_HSC","Adult_HSC")
stage_pseudotime <- lapply(stages,function(i,col_data){
  x <- col_data[,'Pseudotime']
  r <- range(x)
  b <- seq(from = r[1], to = r[2], length.out = 100)
  stage_tbl <- col_data[col_data$stage %in% i,]
  table(cut(stage_tbl$Pseudotime, breaks = b , include.lowest = TRUE))
},col_data=col_data)
names(stage_pseudotime) <- stages
stage_pseudotime_tbl <- do.call(rbind,stage_pseudotime)
#pheatmap(stage_pseudotime_tbl,scale="row",cluster_rows = F,cluster_cols = F)

logcounts_frm <- read.table("D:/HSC_Autophagy/Markdown/3.scATFR/ext_data/EHT_analysis/pseudotime/diff_res/ysmooth_logcounts_frm.tsv",sep="\t",header=T,row.names=1)

activate_score_frm <- read.table("D:/HSC_Autophagy/Markdown/3.scATFR/ext_data/EHT_analysis/pseudotime/diff_res/activate_score_frm.tsv",sep="\t",header=T,row.names=1)
overlap_genes <- intersect(row.names(logcounts_frm),row.names(activate_score_frm))

overlap_genes_merged <- data.frame(expression = logcounts_frm[overlap_genes,"pattern"], active_score=activate_score_frm[overlap_genes,"pattern"])
row.names(overlap_genes_merged) <- overlap_genes
library("easyalluvial")
library("parcats")
data <- overlap_genes_merged
p = alluvial_wide(data, max_variables = 2,fill_by = "last_variable", order_levels=rev(paste("pattern",1:8,sep="")))
pa <- parcats(p, marginal_histograms = FALSE, data_input = data)

3 pathway enrichment analysis

3.1 reactome pathway in different patterns

#---pathways similarity analysis
atfr <- readRDS("D:/HSC_Autophagy/Markdown/3.scATFR/ext_data/EHT_analysis/objects/atfr.rds")
activate_score_regulon <- as.list(Regulon(atfr)[row.names(activate_score_frm)])
reactome_pathway <- readRDS("D:/HSC_Autophagy/Markdown/3.scATFR/scATFR/inst/extdata/Reactome_pathway.rds")
mouse_reactome <- reactome_pathway$`Mus musculus`
mouse_reactome_num <- sapply(mouse_reactome,length)
mouse_reactome_filter <- mouse_reactome[between(mouse_reactome_num,10,500)]

score_cst_regulons_reactome <- calcuModuleSimilar(tfr_list = activate_score_regulon, pathway_list = mouse_reactome_filter, adjust = "BH" , ncores=6, fdr = 0.05, min_overlap = 5)
score_cst_regulons_reactome$pattern <- activate_score_frm[score_cst_regulons_reactome$regulon,"cluster"]
saveRDS(score_cst_regulons_reactome,"D:/HSC_Autophagy/Markdown/3.scATFR/ext_data/EHT_analysis/pseudotime/diff_res/pathway/All_8_patterns_reactome_enrichment_res.rds")
fwrite(score_cst_regulons_reactome,"D:/HSC_Autophagy/Markdown/3.scATFR/ext_data/EHT_analysis/pseudotime/diff_res/pathway/All_8_patterns_reactome_enrichment_res.tsv",sep="\t")

score_cst_regulons_reactome_list <- split(score_cst_regulons_reactome$pathway,score_cst_regulons_reactome$regulon)
overlp_term_frm <- calcuModuleSimilar(tfr_list = score_cst_regulons_reactome_list, pathway_list = score_cst_regulons_reactome_list, adjust = "BH" , ncores=6, fdr = 0.05, min_overlap = 1,collapse_set = F)
overlp_term_frm_sig <- overlp_term_frm %>% filter(padj<0.05) %>% filter(regulon != pathway)
overlp_term_frm_sig_int <- as.data.frame(t(apply(overlp_term_frm_sig[,1:2],1,function(x){sort(x)})))
overlp_term_frm_sig_int <- cbind(overlp_term_frm_sig_int,overlp_term_frm_sig[,3:4])
overlp_term_frm_sig_int <- unique(overlp_term_frm_sig_int)

overlp_term_mat <- matrix(0, nrow=length(score_cst_regulons_reactome_list),ncol=length(score_cst_regulons_reactome_list))
dimnames(overlp_term_mat) <- list(names(score_cst_regulons_reactome_list), names(score_cst_regulons_reactome_list))
for(i in names(score_cst_regulons_reactome_list)){
  for(j in names(score_cst_regulons_reactome_list)){
    overlp_term_mat[i,j] <- length(intersect(score_cst_regulons_reactome_list[[i]],score_cst_regulons_reactome_list[[j]]))
    
  }
}
diag(overlp_term_mat) <- 0
overlp_term_mat_melt <- reshape2::melt(overlp_term_mat) %>% filter(value>0)
overlp_term_mat_melt <- as.data.frame(t(apply(overlp_term_mat_melt,1,function(x){c(sort(x[1:2]),x[3])}))) %>% unique()
write.table(overlp_term_frm_sig_int,"D:/HSC_Autophagy/Markdown/3.scATFR/ext_data/EHT_analysis/pseudotime/diff_res/network/diff_activate_score_similarity_network.tsv",sep="\t",row.names = F,quote=F)
